_meta.title: England & Wales: stop and search by ethnicity, by police force area, 2010/11-2025/26
_meta.measures: How often police stopped and searched people of each ethnic group per 1,000 residents, and how many times more often than white people (disparity). 1 = same rate as white people; 4 = four times as often.
_meta.value: value = black_disparity_vs_white in the latest year shown
_meta.source: Home Office, Police powers and procedures: Stop and search, arrests and mental health detentions, England and Wales, year ending 31 March 2026 (published 1 October 2026)

notes: Rates use 2011 Census population for 2010/11-2019/20 and 2021 Census for 2020/21-2025/26; take care comparing across 2019/20-2020/21 (Home Office).
City of London rates should be read with caution: low resident population, many visitors (Home Office).
British Transport Police is in the source but polices the rail network, so it has no outline.
_meta.groups: Self-defined ethnicity: asian, black, mixed, other, white, not_stated (no rate for not_stated)

properties.name: British Transport Police
properties.note: No outline: this force has no single police force area (kept without geometry).
